🧬 Plus Two Zoology Christmas Exam 2026 – Structure of DNA | Important Concepts & Exam Preparation

Preparing for the Kerala Plus Two Zoology Christmas Exam 2026? Learn the important topic Structure of DNA from the chapter Molecular Basis of Inheritance with clear explanations and exam-focused revision.

In this RK Nex Plus Two Zoology session, we discuss the structure of DNA, the Watson and Crick double helix model, nucleotide composition, complementary base pairing, and important structural features of DNA.

Strengthen your understanding of DNA structure and prepare for important concept-based and diagram-based examination questions.

📌 In This Video:

✅ Plus Two Zoology Christmas Exam 2026
✅ Structure of DNA – Important Topic
✅ Watson and Crick Double Helix Model
✅ DNA Nucleotide Structure
✅ Sugar-Phosphate Backbone
✅ Nitrogenous Bases in DNA
✅ Purines and Pyrimidines
✅ Adenine, Thymine, Guanine and Cytosine
✅ Complementary Base Pairing
✅ Chargaff's Rule
✅ Hydrogen Bonds in DNA
✅ Antiparallel DNA Strands
✅ Important Features of the DNA Double Helix
✅ DNA Structure Diagram
✅ Important NCERT Biology Concepts
✅ Diagram-Based Zoology Questions
✅ Important Short-Answer Questions
✅ Christmas Exam Zoology Revision
✅ Plus Two Biology Board Exam 2027 Preparation

🎯 Why Watch This Video?

Structure of DNA is a fundamental topic in Plus Two Zoology. Understanding the double helix model, nucleotide arrangement, and base-pairing rules helps students answer structural, diagram-based, and concept-based questions confidently.

This session helps students revise the essential concepts of DNA structure and strengthen their preparation for the Christmas Examination.

🚨 Don't skip this important Structure of DNA topic!

💯 Understand the structure. Remember the key features. Prepare with confidence!
